tokens.name: rating-prime
tokens.usage: A species at its peak (FishingRating.excellent). Pin balloon, legend dot, badge wash and stroke. DS.Rating.prime = Color.red, so it shifts by appearance. Values are what iOS 26 resolves, confirmed by matching all six adjacent-stop lightness gaps RampLightnessTests recorded on an iPhone 18 Pro simulator (2026-09-20).

tokens.name: rating-good
tokens.usage: A species in a good stretch (FishingRating.good). DS.Rating.good = Color.orange. Too light for a white glyph (2.31:1), so its pins draw a black one.

tokens.name: rating-fair
tokens.usage: The shoulder of a season (FishingRating.fair). Also the cap applied when a seasonRisk row matches. DS.Rating.fair = Color.yellow. A fill, never text: pins draw a black glyph on it.

tokens.name: rating-slow
tokens.usage: Nothing notable in season (FishingRating.poor). The cold end of the ramp. DS.Rating.slow = Color.blue.

tokens.name: rating-unrated
tokens.usage: No curated season data. A normal state for inland launches, never an error. DS.Rating.unrated = Color.gray; also the Closed badge's wash and stroke.

tokens.name: overlay-density
tokens.usage: The heat overlay's one hue, at four opacities. Violet because the rating ramp gave that hue up — an overlay band must never read as a rating. Tuned against a muted basemap; do not swap it for systemPurple and do not drop the muting.

tokens.name: chrome-rivers-on
tokens.usage: DS.Chrome.riversOn. Fill behind the Rivers toggle when on, under a white label. System teal carries white at only about 2.6:1, so this is a literal deep teal between the icon's two gradient stops, one value in both appearances.

tokens.name: chrome-heat-on
tokens.usage: DS.Chrome.heatOn. Fill behind the Heat toggle when on: overlay-density's light value in both appearances, because the overlay's dark value is lightened for a dark map and cannot carry white text.

tokens.name: chrome-toggle-off
tokens.usage: A layer toggle when off: UIColor.tertiarySystemFill under a text-primary label.

tokens.name: brand-icon-start
tokens.usage: Top stop of the app icon's linear gradient. Shallow-water teal.

tokens.name: brand-icon-end
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the app icon's gradient. Deep-water blue.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: The fish body and tail knocked out of the icon gradient. The mark is white on gradient, always.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on a sheet. UIColor.label.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting sentences, legend labels, bait and best-months rows. UIColor.secondaryLabel.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: UIColor.tertiaryLabel. No longer used for app text: fine print moved to ink-fineprint because tertiary measured about 1.7:1 on white. Kept so older notes resolve; do not use it for anything a person must read.

tokens.name: ink-fineprint
tokens.usage: DS.Ink.fineprint (UIColor.secondaryLabel). Disclaimers, attribution, 'Guidance updated' stamps, axis words, the heat legend's qualifier. Size, not lightness, separates it from the supporting text above it.

tokens.name: surface-background
tokens.usage: Sheet ground, and the disc behind a pin's closure badge. UIColor.systemBackground.

tokens.name: surface-grouped
tokens.usage: Grouped content behind a sheet's sections. UIColor.secondarySystemBackground.

tokens.name: surface-advisory
tokens.usage: DS.Surface.advisory — the 'Before you go' block. A neutral fill on purpose: the old yellow wash collided with the Fair rating on the same sheet.

tokens.name: surface-species-row
tokens.usage: DS.Surface.speciesRow — one species card inside 'What's biting'.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a species name and the line under it; gap between heat-legend swatches.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Dot-to-label gap inside one legend entry.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tightest stack inside a protected-area notice.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label rows in the heat legend; vertical padding on a rating badge is 5px, the one odd value.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Guidance footer stack; sheet padding on compact width.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The workhorse. Species-row padding, badge horizontal padding, legend entry gap, most sheet stacks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Guidance footer padding; sheet padding on regular width.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on a detail sheet.

tokens.name: radius-chrome
tokens.usage: DS.Surface.chromeRadius — the floating map chrome card (Liquid Glass on iOS 26, ultraThinMaterial before it).

tokens.name: radius-advisory
tokens.usage: DS.Surface.advisoryRadius — the 'Before you go' block.

tokens.name: radius-species-row
tokens.usage: DS.Surface.speciesRowRadius — a species card in 'What's biting'.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: The heat legend's four-swatch strip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsule: the rating badge and the MA-number map label.

tokens.name: density-band-0
tokens.usage: The coldest heat band draws nothing, so the basemap stays clean where there is nothing to say.

tokens.name: density-band-1
tokens.usage: Second heat band.

tokens.name: density-band-2
tokens.usage: Third heat band.

tokens.name: density-band-3
tokens.usage: Densest heat band. Cells tile without overlapping, so this is exactly what renders.

tokens.name: badge-fill
tokens.usage: A rating or Closed badge's background is its colour at this opacity, with a 1px stroke at full strength. The label is text-primary, not the rating colour.

tokens.name: pin-closed
tokens.usage: A closed site's pin fades to this but stays tappable — the details are one tap away.

tokens.name: marker-pin
tokens.usage: How large a site pin draws relative to MKMarkerAnnotationView's own size. The class has no size property, so this is a transform applied in layoutSubviews and prepareForDisplay. At full size the balloons covered the place labels they sit beside at regional zoom.

tokens.name: marker-cluster
tokens.usage: The cluster badge's scale. Kept a fixed step above marker-pin (about 1.19x it) so a count never reads as one spot. Scaling happens about the view's centre, so both are translated by half the height change to keep the balloon's tip on its coordinate.
